<tspan x="1272.0" dy="0">Tensor operations</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="869.0" y="1633" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="869.0" dy="0">Gate width4H=64; all three terms have the same static[B,64] shape.</tspan>
<tspan x="869.0" dy="16.52">Shared Wx/Uz producers fan out to distinct real operand ports; colors do not imply weight sharing.</tspan>
<tspan x="869.0" dy="16.52">The top boundary ends before chunk4; the standard LSTM suffix is outside this figure.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="869.0" y="1737" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="869.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="869.0" y="1767" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="869.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="869.0" y="1792" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="869.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
